methodology.design: Exploratory reuse of 40 frozen questions, three models, four profiles; 480 trajectories. No tuning, retries or fresh-holdout/generalization claim. All generation failures remain in denominators.

blinding.identity: Frozen answer_identity(ordinal, answer): first 20 hex digits of SHA256 UTF-8 results.json:{ordinal}:{answer}; opaque keys only, private row/model/profile mapping never sent to reviewers.
blinding.protocol: Reuse frozen make_packet, scope_for, standards, clarifications, guidance, review_instructions and review_format without changing originals.

validation: Exactly 40 unique cases and all 480 unique case/model/profile combinations.
Exactly 40 input and review files 00.json through 39.json, 12 identities each, one question per group.
Reject duplicate JSON object keys, missing/extra/duplicate identities, missing/unknown/duplicate criteria, nonboolean support grades, invalid verdicts and malformed review fields.
Verify prepared results, cases, scope, input files, protocol source and answer SHA256 hashes against current artifacts and regenerate expected packets from frozen make_packet.
All nonempty criterion quotations must occur literally in that answer; supported criteria and material errors require nonempty own-answer quotations.

Complete requires completed nonfailed generation, no missing items or material errors, and support for every required criterion. Materially incorrect requires quoted material error; material errors require materially_incorrect verdict.
Identical question plus exact answer must have identical verdict and criterion-support mapping.
Any validation or ledger reconciliation failure suppresses quality comparisons and all gate claims; write all discovered failures to analysis.json and return nonzero.

metrics.supported: Number with complete_supported verdict; denominator includes failures.
metrics.material_errors: Number of answers with materially_incorrect verdict; also report total individual quoted errors.
metrics.strict_all: Complete_supported and all criteria supported, including optional criteria.
metrics.tokens: Cumulative provider-reported input plus output tokens across all API turns, including reasoning counted in provider output. Never add reasoning a second time.
metrics.efficiency: Total cumulative tokens or conservative charged USD divided by supported answers; null when no supported answers.
metrics.summary: Per model/profile n, supported/rate, material errors/rate, strict_all, mean/median/total tokens, total/mean cost, tokens and cost per supported answer, calls/requests and failures. Also descriptive model summaries pooling all four fixed profiles; not proof of generalization.

bootstrap.unit: Question, paired across all arms. Sort case IDs; for every draw use random.Random(seed).choice(keys) 40 times with replacement. Reset seed for every comparison. Equal question weighting.
bootstrap.interval: Percentile endpoints sorted samples indices 250 and 9749 (zero based). Undefined zero-denominator ratio draws are counted, not silently discarded; interval null if any draw undefined. No multiplicity adjustment; descriptive exploratory intervals.

gates.source: reserved_confirm_20261003/analyze_confirm.py lines 39-45: original validation gate, not development gate.

criteria.no_net_pass_loss: Candidate supported count >= reference supported count.
criteria.no_extra_material_errors: Candidate materially-incorrect count <= reference materially-incorrect count.
criteria.accuracy_difference_lower_ge_-0.05: Paired supported-proportion difference bootstrap lower endpoint >= -0.05.
criteria.token_ratio_upper_lt_1.0: Paired cumulative-token ratio bootstrap upper endpoint < 1.0.
criteria.mean_token_ratio_le_0.85: Unrounded candidate/reference mean cumulative token ratio <= 0.85.

gates.primary: Unchanged five-condition conjunction for split/native separately within each model.
gates.secondary: Apply the same five conditions to aider/native, repomix/native, split/aider and split/repomix descriptively; no new cross-model or cross-comparison conjunction, no promotion selection.
gates.claim: No success claim for a failed per-model gate, invalid reviews, or unknown provider token usage. No overall promotion/generalization claim even if all gates pass.

ledger.ceiling_source: Read model_ceiling_usd and total_ceiling_usd from pre-request frozen protocol.json; require aggregate spend_ledger.json ceiling_usd agrees. Do not infer or change ceilings from results.
ledger.reconcile: Map ledger identity market/{schedule_ordinal:04d}/turn-N to unique row; require matching model and no duplicate request identities. Report ledger/API-turn counts and conservative charge totals, row charge totals, model/profile costs, all failed requests/trajectories and discrepancies. Charge tolerance absolute 1e-8 USD. Each API-turn charge is the full ledger entry; usage must match. Row tokens must equal cumulative known ledger input/output usage and row cost must equal all ledger charges. Nonfailed rows require exact API-turn ledger coverage; failed rows may omit API turns but omitted charges and identities are explicitly reported. Unknown provider usage is not invented: known-token totals are lower bounds, usage uncertainty is disclosed and success claims suppressed for affected comparisons. Each shard and aggregate must remain within its frozen protocol ceiling.

methodology.provenance: Parent freezes code, methodology and final context_production/contexts.json and context_production/competitor_manifest.json before API requests. Root preflight context files are not the actual treatment. Original frozen outcomes are never read.

interpretation: Per-model split/native validation gates and secondary comparisons are descriptive on reused questions. Failed gates or incomplete token usage do not permit a success claim; no fresh-generalization or overall promotion claim.
overall_gate: Not defined: report unchanged split/native validation gate separately for each model; no cross-model conjunction or promotion selection.

competitors.component: actual aider.repomap.RepoMap, not full coding agent

scope.rule: All *.py below corpus/src when present; otherwise all *.py below root import-package directories containing __init__.py, including leading-underscore packages. Root tests/docs/examples/scripts directories are excluded. Same source list for both competitors.
scope.native_tool_scope: Shared native read/grep can access the full frozen corpus, broader than production-only initial context.
scope.selection_note: Generic source-only configuration chosen before answer generation to control context cost; no question/rubric-based selection.
scope.non_python_files: Not part of this shared source-code scope.
scope.symlinks: Directory symlinks are not traversed; source-file symlinks are rejected.

competitors.token_costs: All cumulative provider input/output tokens, including repeated context; costs are published-rate charges/bounds, not invoices. Source review and local indexing costs excluded.

interruptions.cause: Parent shell watchdog terminated two generation processes after 3600 seconds, not a provider/model failure.
interruptions.policy: No retry or regeneration of interrupted/completed trajectories; preserve successful request tokens and unresolved reservation, count interrupted answers unsupported, continue only never-attempted rows using unchanged frozen driver with shell timeout disabled.
interruptions.sensitivity_predeclared: Alongside unchanged primary analysis, report supplementary paired comparisons excluding each affected model-question from every profile of that model. Not a replacement verdict; exclude by host-interruption identity only, before grading.

interruption_sensitivity.role: Supplementary descriptive sensitivity; NEVER replaces the unchanged primary analysis.
interruption_sensitivity.rule_record: interruptions.json, recorded after generation began but before any new-study grading.
interruption_sensitivity.exclusion_rule: Drop every profile of the affected model-question, not just the interrupted answer.

grading.method: Arm/model-blind coding-assistant source review, not independent human validation.
grading.early_inputs: 31 groups reviewed as soon as all twelve answers existed; final frozen prepare output identical after physical CRLF/LF normalization, parsed JSON identical. Evidence in early_grading_transfer.json.

corrections.reason: Corrected nonverbatim quote prefix/capitalization; criterion support and verdict unchanged.
Added omitted identity review, incomplete. No previous grade existed.
Restored literal backticks in quote; support and verdict unchanged.

verification.python_syntax: py_compile passed for all three pre-registered drivers.
verification.runtime: Actual upstream context generation, offline native/control/split tool dispatch and 480 real provider trajectories exercised.
verification.accounting: All 1879 request records reconcile with trajectory usage/cost; one interrupted request has unknown usage and keeps reserved cost bound.
verification.lint: Full Ruff check reported line-length/import-order style diagnostics; no clean lint claim. Frozen research scripts were not restyled after registration.

decision: Luna+split4 has the lowest observed tokens and API cost per supported answer among cells with supported answers; no primary validation gate passed. Do not promote or claim fresh generalization from this reused-question matrix.
